verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents Actions, its automation primitive for login and identity flows, as "versioned Node.js functions". First-party config-as-code tooling (Auth0 CLI for tenant configuration, a Terraform module) and the MCP server can deploy Actions. No evidence explicitly documents reviewing version diffs or rolling back to a prior Action version, so only the versioning part of the story is clearly shown. Missing for 10: documented rollback to prior Action versions, a review/diff or approval workflow for automation changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
